content.overview: The document provides a clinical guideline for adults with congenital heart disease (ACHD), focusing on pharmacological therapies and specific lesion treatments.

pharmacological_therapy.management_of_heart_failure: 2017 ACC/AHA/HFSA focused update for the 2013 ACCF/AHA guideline uses beta blockers, including carvedilol or metoprolol XL, for adults with congenital heart disease and dysfunction of the systemic right ventricle.
pharmacological_therapy.epoprostenol_use: Epoprostenol use in adults with cyanotic congenital heart disease with Eisenmenger syndrome.
pharmacological_therapy.angiotensin_receptor_blockade: Angiotensin receptor blockade, with drugs like valsartan, improves systemic right ventricular function in adults.
pharmacological_therapy.ramipril_use: Ramipril in patients with repaired tetralogy of Fallot for the optimization of right atrial size and prevention of heart failure.

specific_lesions.atrial_septal_defect: Surgical and transcatheter closure options for atrial septal defect in adults, including long-term outcomes and complications.
specific_lesions.patent_foramen_ovale: Catheter device closure of patent foramen ovale and its impact on reducing stroke risk.
